body:
I had an epiphany that you may also apply [to the prior PR](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107564).
Also every qualifier is impersonal, so referring to the second person is inconsistent here.
```suggestion
			hint = TTR("This method is called automatically for every script that overrides it.\nThis means that the base implementation should not be called via super in GDScript\nor its equivalents in other languages.");
```
